description:
Create AI-powered short-form video clips from YouTube videos using any AI assistant.

9 tools: create shorts, browse caption templates, background music, gameplay overlays, and meme hooks. Track processing status, retrieve results with viral scores, and manage request history.

Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client.
